verdict.rationale: Lighthouse lists a 'Candidate Eligibility Evaluation' as included on its pricing page, and its O-1A page says the team maps a founder's accomplishments to the USCIS criteria before preparing the case. That confirms a pre-filing qualification assessment exists, but the evidence does not describe how the evaluation is structured or what the founder receives. The only self-serve criteria quiz shown is for EB-1A, not O-1A. Missing for 10: documented O-1A assessment methodology (criterion-by-criterion scoring or a written evaluation deliverable), an O-1A-specific eligibility tool, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assessment process.
